We study whether protective cold-response programmes, including RBM3-associated pathways, can
be engaged without sustained cooling. In skin models, we examine how these responses relate to
mitochondrial function, stress tolerance and regenerative capacity.

## Research context

This direction builds on our published studies of cellular and muscle adaptation to mild
hypothermia. Compound identities, screening designs and development details are not disclosed.
